# 0.09 A fixed-point field and a compensated sum
Task: the storage of numbers: a half-precision or fixed-point field and a compensated sum
Shape: QUDA include/color_spinor_field_order.h (FloatNOrder with Float = short: each real kept as a 16-bit integer, with one float norm per site, the site's largest size, stored after the field), include/kernels/reduce_core.cuh (the sums of a reduction kept in a wider type)
Write a field that keeps each real as a 16-bit integer with one float scale per site, the site's largest size.
Read the field back and add every real by compensated summation, in float.
Measure the error of the sum against its exact value, and check it against Higham's bound with the unit roundoff of IEEE 754 binary32.

## Bound
Tag: 9.37
Count: the bytes the routine loads per site for a field of three complex numbers in half precision
Answer: 16
Source: QUDA include/color_spinor_field_order.h: FloatNOrder<short, 1, 3, …> holds length = 2 · Ns · Nc = 6 reals per site, each a short of 2 bytes, and load() reads one norm of norm_t = float per site at x + norm_offset
Derivation 1: six reals of 2 bytes, 12 bytes, and one float norm of 4 bytes: 12 + 4 = 16.
Derivation 2: in single precision the site takes 6 · 4 = 24 bytes; halving the reals gives 12, and the norm the half field adds is one float, 4 bytes: 16.

Tag: 9.37
```cpp

#include <cstdint>
#include <print>

int main()
{
    float t {32767.6f};
    auto q {static_cast<std::int16_t>(std::lround(t))};
    std::println("{}", q);
}
```

Answer: c++23 defined

## Alone 1
Tag: 9.29
Newer: 58
Form: run
Write a program that reads n sites of six reals, stores them as 16-bit integers with one scale per site, and adds what it reads back.
The scale s of a site is the largest |x| among its six reals. Store each x as q: t = x / s, then t · 32767, each step in float; q is std::lround(t) kept in a std::int16_t.
Read each real back as v = q converted to float, divided by 32767.0f, then times s, in float.
Add the 6n values v, site by site and in order within a site, by compensated summation in float, with the corrections added up apart. Start from r = 0 and c = 0. For each v, let a be whichever of r and v is larger in size, r when they are the same size, and b the other; compute t = a + b, then e = (a − t) + b, then set c = c + e and r = t. At the end, the sum is r + c.
Take the error E = sum − S, where S is the exact sum of the 6n values v, which __float128 holds exactly.
Input: one line, n; then n lines, the six reals of one site on each, read as floats.
Output: one line: sum, then E rounded to a double, each as std::format prints it with {:a}; then yes if |E| ≤ (2u + m²u²) · Σ|v| with m = 6n terms and u = 2^−24, the unit roundoff of IEEE 754 binary32, or no if not. That is the bound Higham proves for this method when mu < 0.1 (§4.3, (4.10)); compute it in __float128.
Limits: 1 ≤ n ≤ 1000, so mu < 0.1; each real is 0 or between 0.001 and 1000 in size; every site holds a real that is not 0.
### Examples
```in
1
0.5 -2 1 0 0 0
```
```out
-1.fff4p-2 0p+0 yes
```
```in
2
1 2 3 4 5 6
-1 0.5 0.25 0 0 0
```
```out
1.4c0078p+4 0p+0 yes
```
### Reference
```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <iostream>
#include <print>
#include <vector>

int main()
{
    int n {0};
    std::cin >> n;
    std::vector<float> x(static_cast<std::size_t>(6 * n));
    for (float& v : x) {
        std::cin >> v;
    }
    std::vector<std::int16_t> q(x.size());
    std::vector<float> scale(static_cast<std::size_t>(n));
    for (int i {0}; i < n; ++i) {
        float s {0.0f};
        for (int j {0}; j < 6; ++j) {
            s = std::fmax(s, std::fabs(x[6 * i + j]));
        }
        scale[i] = s;
        for (int j {0}; j < 6; ++j) {
            float t {x[6 * i + j] / s * 32767.0f};
            long r {std::lround(t)};
            q[6 * i + j] = static_cast<std::int16_t>(r);
        }
    }
    float sum {0.0f};
    float c {0.0f};
    __float128 exact {0};
    __float128 size {0};
    for (int i {0}; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j {0}; j < 6; ++j) {
            float v {static_cast<float>(q[6 * i + j])};
            v = v / 32767.0f;
            v = v * scale[i];
            float a {sum};
            float b {v};
            if (std::fabs(a) < std::fabs(b)) {
                std::swap(a, b);
            }
            float t {a + b};
            c = c + ((a - t) + b);
            sum = t;
            exact = exact + v;
            size = size + (v < 0.0f ? -v : v);
        }
    }
    float total {sum + c};
    __float128 error {total - exact};
    __float128 away {error < 0 ? -error : error};
    __float128 u {0x1p-24};
    __float128 m {6 * n * u};
    bool inside {away <= (2 * u + m * m) * size};
    double e {static_cast<double>(error)};
    std::println("{:a} {:a} {}", total, e,
                 inside ? "yes" : "no");
}
```
